quizzes.title: MCQ: Last-digit rules
quizzes.instructions: Look only at the last digit.

questions.explanation: 9,715 ends in 5. The others end in 2, 8 and 4.

questions.prompt: A number is divisible by 10. What else must divide it?
questions.explanation: 10 = 2 × 5, so every multiple of 10 is a multiple of both 2 and 5.

questions.prompt: Which digit should replace ★ so that 43★ is divisible by 2 but NOT by 5?
questions.explanation: ★ = 2 gives 432: even (ends in 2) and not ending in 0 or 5, so not divisible by 5. ★ = 0 gives 430 (divisible by 5 ✗); ★ = 5 and ★ = 7 give odd numbers (435, 437).

quizzes.title: MCQ: Divisibility by 4 and 8
quizzes.instructions: Last two digits for 4, last three for 8.

options.text: No — digit sum is not divisible by 4
No — the number is odd? It is even, so yes
Yes — it ends in an even digit

questions.explanation: Divisibility by 4 depends on the last two digits: 12 is a multiple of 4. An even last digit only guarantees divisibility by 2.
Last three digits 888 = 8 × 111 ✓. The other last-three-digit groups (316, 124, 020) are not multiples of 8.

questions.prompt: A number is divisible by 8. Which statement follows?

options.text: Its digit sum is divisible by 8

questions.explanation: 8 = 4 × 2, so every multiple of 8 is a multiple of 4. The converse is false, and digit sums relate to 9 and 3, not 8.

quizzes.title: MCQ: Divisibility by 6
quizzes.instructions: Both conditions — even AND digit sum divisible by 3 — are required.

options.text: Yes — it is even and 2 + 3 + 4 + 0 = 9 is divisible by 3
No — the digit sum is too small
Only if it is also divisible by 9

questions.explanation: Both tests pass: even last digit, digit sum 9 divisible by 3. Indeed 2,340 = 6 × 390.

questions.prompt: The number 3,213 has digit sum 9 but is not divisible by 6. Why?

options.text: It is odd, so it fails the test for 2
It is divisible by 6 — the premise is false

questions.explanation: Passing the digit-sum test for 3 is only half the requirement; 3,213 ends in 3 and is odd, so it is not divisible by 6.

questions.prompt: Which of these is divisible by 6?
questions.explanation: 7,116 is even with digit sum 15 (divisible by 3) ✓. 7,114 has digit sum 13; 7,113 and 7,115 are odd.

quizzes.title: MCQ: Combining the rules
quizzes.instructions: Split composite divisors into coprime parts.

questions.prompt: To test divisibility by 15, which two tests should be combined?
questions.explanation: 15 = 3 × 5 with 3 and 5 coprime, so both tests must pass.

options.text: Because 2 and 6 share the factor 2 — 18 passes both tests yet 12 ∤ 18

questions.explanation: Parts must be coprime. 18 is divisible by both 2 and 6 but not by 12, showing the tests are not equivalent.

options.text: Yes — digit sum 18 passes for 3 and last two digits 36 pass for 4

questions.explanation: Digit sum 5+4+3+6 = 18 is divisible by 3 ✓ and 36 = 4 × 9 ✓, so 5,436 = 12 × 453.
